timer_api.h

Open, start, stop, and read one timer.

After timer_open(), configure the period with timer_set_period_us(), declared in the socfpga_timer.h driver header included below. Set it again after timer_stop(), which clears the configuration. Starting without a configured period returns -EINVAL.

timer_open
timer_handle_t timer_open(
timer_instance_t 
instance
)

Open one timer and release its reset if the block is held in reset.

Parameters
instance
timer_instance_t

TIMER_SYS0, TIMER_SYS1, TIMER_SP0, or TIMER_SP1.

Returns

A handle on success. NULL when instance is out of range, already open, reset status cannot be read or released, or the timer clock rate cannot be resolved.

timer_start
int32_t timer_start(
timer_handle_t 
htimer
)

Start a timer that has already been configured.

timer_open() does not set a period. Call timer_set_period_us(), declared in the socfpga_timer.h driver header included above, before each start.  Starting without a configured period returns -EINVAL. timer_stop() clears that configuration, so set the period again before restarting.

Parameters
htimer
timer_handle_t

Handle from timer_open(). NULL is rejected.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL when htimer is NULL or the timer is not configured. -EBUSY when it is already running.

timer_stop
int32_t timer_stop(
timer_handle_t 
htimer
)

Stop a running timer. Stopping clears the configured state.

Parameters
htimer
timer_handle_t

Handle from timer_open(). NULL is rejected.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL when htimer is NULL. -EPERM when the timer is not running.

timer_close
int32_t timer_close(
timer_handle_t 
htimer
)

Closes a timer handle and releases the underlying timer instance.

Parameters
htimer
timer_handle_t

Handle returned by timer_open().

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if htimer is NULL or does not identify an open timer; -EFAULT if the timer instance cannot be released from the driver table.

timer_deinit
int32_t timer_deinit(
timer_handle_t 
htimer
)

Provides the deinitialization alias for timer_close().

Parameters
htimer
timer_handle_t

Handle returned by timer_open().

Returns

The same status returned by timer_close().

timer_get_time_us
int32_t timer_get_time_us(
timer_handle_t 
htimer,
uint32_t 
*
time_us
)

Reads the current timer value in microseconds.

Parameters
htimer
timer_handle_t

Handle returned by timer_open().

time_us
uint32_t*

Receives the current timer value in microseconds.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if htimer or time_us is NULL or the timer clock rate is unavailable; -EPERM if the timer is not running.
